title: Gift bag with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bag' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff6fa8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d63b7a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8a020'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M30 32 C30 14, 70 14, 70 32' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 32 C30 18, 70 18, 70 32' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bag body -->
  <rect x='20' y='32' width='60' height='58' rx='6' fill='url(#bag)'/>
  <!-- top fold / rim -->
  <rect x='20' y='32' width='60' height='11' rx='5' fill='#b02f66'/>
  <rect x='23' y='33.5' width='54' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e05a91'/>

  <!-- side highlight -->
  <rect x='24' y='46' width='7' height='38' rx='3.5' fill='#ff8fbb' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- gift ribbon vertical -->
  <rect x='46.5' y='43' width='7' height='47' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='48' y='44' width='2' height='45' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='62' r='5.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='62' r='5.5' fill='#2a1030'/>
  <circle cx='38.8' cy='60' r='1.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64.8' cy='60' r='1.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='72' r='4.5' fill='#ff9cc2' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='72' r='4.5' fill='#ff9cc2' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 72 Q50 82 60 72' fill='none' stroke='#2a1030' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 73 Q50 80 58 73' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fb5' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bow on top of bag -->
  <path d='M50 40 L40 34 L42 41 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M50 40 L60 34 L58 41 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='3.2' fill='#f2a91c'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='38' r='1' fill='#fff4c0'/>
</svg>
